title: Idolobhana Esogwini Lwecala
intro: Uzithola usedolobhaneni elisogwini, lapho umsindo wamagagasi uxubana khona nokuhleba kwabantu abakhohliwe. Banikwa umyalo wokuphumula, kodwa ubugovu babo baholela esijezisweni esisakhulunywa ngaso ngamazwi athule. Ungabathola ukuthi bangobani?
clues: Sasihlala ngasogwini futhi sanikwa umyalo wokugcina usuku lokuphumula.
Ngalolo suku, izinhlanzi zaziza kithi ngobuningi, kodwa sasingavunyelwe ukuzithatha.
Abanye phakathi kwethu baxwayisa ngokuphula umthetho, kodwa abanye bahlela ukudoba noma kunjalo.
Sephule umyalo ongcwele futhi sazilethela isijeziso esinzima.
Isijeziso sethu sasiwuguquko olwasishiya singcolile futhi sihlazekile.
Saphendulwa saba yizinkawu, isibonakaliso kubo bonke ababezolandela.
arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
